Callout.Name: Drink Driver in the County
Callout.Message: Vehicle in a ditch, driver still at the wheel.
Callout.Advisory: Driver out and unsteady, no other vehicles involved.

Script.Line: I have not had anything. I swerved for a deer.
It is my mate who owns the truck. He lent it to me.
I am in the ditch and I am fine. That is the main thing.

Lines.Approach: He is in the ditch and he is already telling the caller he is fine. He is not fine.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
